공책.x: I write new words in my notebook.
공책.t: A book with blank pages to write in.

피아노.x: I learned piano when I was a child.
피아노.t: 'Play the piano' = 피아노를 치다 (치다 = hit, strike).

마시다.e: Used for drinks: 물/커피/술을 마시다. Soup and medicine usually take 먹다.
마시다.t: 마시 + 어요 contracts to 마셔요. For elders, 드시다 is used for drinking too.

그리다.x: The child drew a cat on paper.
그리다.e: Related to 그림 (picture, drawing). A different 그리다 means 'to miss, long for'.

다치다.m: to get hurt, to be injured
다치다.x: I hurt my leg while playing soccer.
다치다.e: Sounds exactly like 닫히다 (to be closed) — context tells them apart.

건너다.x: Cross the street when the light is green.
건너다.e: 길을 건너다 = cross the street; 건너편 = the other side.

또.forms: 또 + verb: 또 왔어요 · 또 만나요 (see you again)
또.e: 또 봐요 = See you again. 또 + 는 = 또는 (or).

모으다.forms: 모아요 · 모았어요 · 모을 거예요 · 모으세요 (ㅡ drops)
모으다.m: to collect, to gather; to save (money)
모으다.ex: 저는 여행을 갈 때마다 엽서를 모아요.
모으다.x: I collect postcards every time I travel.
모으다.e: Same root as 모이다 'to gather together' and 모임 'gathering'.
모으다.t: 돈을 모으다 means 'to save up money' — a very common phrase.

덮다.ex: 오늘 밤은 추우니까 이불을 덮고 주무세요.
덮다.x: It's cold tonight, so sleep with a blanket over you.
덮다.e: Source of 덮개 'cover' and 덮밥 'rice topped with food'.
덮다.t: 책을 덮다 = to close a book; 책을 펴다 = to open it.

정장.ex: 면접 날에 검은색 정장을 입고 갔어요.
정장.x: I wore a black suit on the day of my interview.
정장.t: 정장 is any formal outfit for men or women; 양복 is specifically a men's Western-style suit.

감.x: In fall, lots of persimmons grow on the persimmon trees.
감.e: Homonym warning: 감 also means 'feeling, hunch', as in 감이 좋다 'to have a good feeling'.

점.ex: 이 계획에서 가장 좋은 점이 뭐라고 생각해요?
점.x: What do you think is the best thing about this plan?
점.t: After numbers it means 'points' on a test: 90점 is 'ninety points'.

점.ex: 그 사람은 입 옆에 작은 점이 있어요.
점.x: That person has a small mole next to their mouth.
점.e: Homonym warning: 점 also means 'dot, point, score,' and a different 점 means fortune-telling.
점.t: 점을 빼다 means to have a mole removed, a common cosmetic procedure in Korea.

마이크.ex: 마이크 소리가 너무 작아서 잘 안 들려요.
마이크.x: The mic is too quiet, so I can't hear well.
마이크.t: At a 노래방, 마이크를 잡다 'to grab the mic' means to take your turn singing.

사회자.ex: 결혼식 사회자는 신랑의 친한 친구가 맡았어요.
사회자.x: The groom's close friend was the MC at the wedding.
사회자.e: Literally 'person managing the meeting'; unrelated to the 사회 meaning 'society'.
사회자.t: To be the MC is 사회를 보다: 제가 사회를 볼게요 'I'll MC.'

비타민.x: Fruit contains a lot of vitamins.
비타민.e: From English 'vitamin', said with a short 'bi' sound: bi-ta-min.
비타민.t: Vitamin C is 비타민 시, and vitamin D is 비타민 디.

지르다.forms: 질러요 · 질렀어요 · 지를 거예요 · 지르세요 (르 irregular)
지르다.m: to yell, scream (with 소리); to kick; to set (fire)
지르다.x: I screamed while watching a scary movie.
지르다.t: Learn it in chunks: 소리를 지르다 'scream', 불을 지르다 'set a fire'.

물놀이.x: The kids are playing in the water at the valley stream.
물놀이.t: Pronounced [물로리]: ㄴ becomes ㄹ after ㄹ. Splashing in a mountain stream is a classic Korean summer family outing.

해산물.ex: 저는 해산물을 좋아해서 새우랑 오징어를 자주 먹어요.
해산물.x: I like seafood, so I often eat shrimp and squid.
해산물.t: In dish names the short form 해물 is used: 해물파전 'seafood pancake', 해물탕 'seafood stew'.

쨍쨍.x: The sun is really blazing down today.
쨍쨍.e: Manner word (의태어) for strong, glaring sunlight with no clouds.
쨍쨍.t: Also used as an adjective: 햇볕이 쨍쨍해요 'The sun is blazing.'

급등.x: The sudden jump in fuel prices has increased the burden on drivers.

지휘자.x: When the conductor raised his hand, the performance began.
지휘자.e: -자 = person who does it: 지휘자, 연주자, 수상자.

눈치가 빠르다.forms: 눈치가 빨라요 · 눈치가 빨랐어요 · 눈치 빠른 사람 (르 irregular)
눈치가 빠르다.m: to be quick to pick up on things, to be perceptive
눈치가 빠르다.ex: 그녀는 눈치가 빨라서 금방 분위기를 알아챘어요.
눈치가 빠르다.x: She's perceptive, so she read the atmosphere right away.

빠짐없이.m: without exception, without missing anything, all
빠짐없이.x: Every employee attended the meeting without exception.
빠짐없이.e: 빠짐 'omission' (from 빠지다 'to be left out') + 없이 'without'.

이른바.x: These days many people do so-called 'honbap' (eating alone).
이른바.e: 이르다 'to call, say' + 바 'that which' — literally 'what is said'.

아니나 다를까.ex: 하늘이 흐리더니 아니나 다를까 비가 오기 시작했어요.
아니나 다를까.x: The sky was cloudy, and sure enough, it started to rain.
아니나 다를까.e: Literally 'would it be otherwise, would it differ?'—a rhetorical 'of course not'.
아니나 다를까.t: Usually for things you predicted, often unwelcome ones.

발을 빼다.m: to back out, to pull out (of an involvement)
발을 빼다.ex: 문제가 생기자 그는 그 사업에서 발을 뺐어요.
발을 빼다.x: When problems came up, he pulled out of that business.
발을 빼다.e: Literally 'to pull one's foot out' of something.

그림체.x: This artist's drawing style is really pretty.
그림체.e: Native 그림 'picture, drawing' + 체 'style' (as in 글씨체 'handwriting').
그림체.t: The everyday word for comics and webtoons; 화풍 is the formal term for a painter's style.

사범님.x: The instructor taught me kicks in detail.
사범님.t: Students call the instructor 사범님 directly; the head of the gym is 관장님.

손이 많이 가다.forms: 손이 많이 가요 · 손이 많이 가는 (+noun)
손이 많이 가다.m: to take a lot of work or care, to be labor-intensive (lit. the hand goes to it a lot)
손이 많이 가다.ex: 김밥은 맛있지만 손이 많이 가는 음식이에요.
손이 많이 가다.x: Gimbap is delicious, but it's a lot of work to make.
손이 많이 가다.e: 손 'hand' stands for work: something that needs your hands again and again.
손이 많이 가다.t: Common for cooking, housework and crafts; also for people who need looking after: 손이 많이 가는 아이. Opposite: 손이 덜 가다.

풍속.ex: 설날에는 어른들께 세배를 하는 풍속이 있어요.
풍속.x: On Lunar New Year, there's a custom of bowing to elders.
풍속.e: Literally 'manners and customs' of a society.
풍속.t: Homonym: 풍속 (風速) also means 'wind speed' in weather reports.

무인화.ex: 요즘 편의점과 식당의 무인화가 빠르게 늘고 있어요.
무인화.x: These days, unstaffed convenience stores and restaurants are increasing quickly.

자회사.ex: 그 회사는 해외에 자회사를 세 곳이나 두고 있어요.
자회사.x: That company has as many as three subsidiaries overseas.
자회사.e: Literally 'child company'; the parent company is 모회사 'mother company'.

선사 시대.ex: 이 박물관에는 선사 시대의 돌도끼가 전시되어 있어요.
선사 시대.x: Stone axes from prehistoric times are on display in this museum.

진술서.ex: 목격자는 경찰서에서 사건 당시 상황에 대한 진술서를 작성했습니다.
진술서.x: At the police station, the witness wrote a statement about what happened at the time.

명목임금.ex: 명목임금은 올랐지만 물가가 더 많이 올랐습니다.
명목임금.x: Nominal wages went up, but prices went up even more.
명목임금.e: Literally 'wages in name only', before adjusting for inflation.
명목임금.t: 명목 also means 'pretext': ~라는 명목으로 'under the pretext of ~'.

날치기.m: ramming a bill through; purse-snatching, snatch theft
날치기.ex: 여당이 예산안을 날치기로 통과시켰다는 비판을 받았어요.
날치기.x: The ruling party was criticized for ramming the budget bill through.
날치기.e: Probably from 날치다 'to dart about swiftly'; first meant snatching purses.
날치기.t: In politics it's usually 날치기 통과; in daily life it means grabbing someone's bag and running.

상임이사국.m: permanent member (of the UN Security Council)
상임이사국.ex: 안보리의 다섯 상임이사국은 모두 거부권을 가지고 있어요.
상임이사국.x: All five permanent members of the Security Council have veto power.
상임이사국.e: Literally 'nation permanently appointed as a director'.

대량학살.ex: 이 박물관은 대량학살의 희생자들을 기억하기 위해 세워졌습니다.
대량학살.x: This museum was built to remember the victims of the mass killing.

악덕.x: Greed has long been regarded as a classic vice.
악덕.e: Literally 'evil character trait', the opposite of 미덕.
악덕.t: Often used before a noun: 악덕 기업 (unscrupulous company), 악덕 업주 (exploitative employer).

사용자경험.ex: 우리 팀은 사용자경험을 개선하기 위해 설문 조사를 했어요.
사용자경험.x: Our team ran a survey to improve the user experience.
사용자경험.e: Literally 'user's experience'; -자 = person who does it: 사용자, 운전자.
사용자경험.t: In tech companies people often just say UX (유엑스) instead.

속속.x: Guests are arriving at the venue one after another.

시발점.ex: 작은 질문 하나가 이 연구의 시발점이 되었어요.
시발점.x: One small question became the starting point of this research.
시발점.t: Pronounced [시발쩜]; in casual speech 출발점 or 시작점 is more common.

변천사.m: history of changes, evolution (of something over time)
변천사.ex: 이 박물관에서 한국 옷의 변천사를 볼 수 있어요.
변천사.x: At this museum you can see how Korean clothing has changed over time.
